home.title: Convergence Classes
home.intro: 27 classes, 27 starting points. Compare the stats, gear and playstyle of each one. Open a class page for its armor, weapons, spells and where to find them in the world, then pick up to four classes to put side by side.
home.itemsLink: Item database: weapons, armor, talismans and their effects →
home.stylesIntro: My own grouping based on starting kits. Click a style to filter the classes.

rempart.name: Bulwark
rempart.text: Heavy or medium-to-heavy armor, Strength first. Dreadnought starts with Vigor 16 and Endurance 15, the highest values in the list. Retainer adds a crossbow and a kite shield.

brute.name: Brute force
brute.text: Big weapons, little finesse. Berserker starts at Strength 18, the highest in the list, at level 7 with a greataxe. Dreadnought prefers the maul and the greatshield.

agile.name: Agility and precision
agile.text: Dexterity from 15 to 18, light to medium armor. Sellsword plays twinblades, Rogue the thrusting sword and shortbow, Marksman ranged weapons with 50 fire arrows.

sorcery.name: Pure sorcery
sorcery.text: Intelligence as the main stat, Mind between 12 and 15. Glint Sorcerer starts at level 6 with INT 16. Each class has its specialty: glintstone, gravity, frozen lightning, frost, briars.

hybrid.name: INT + FTH spellblade
hybrid.text: Two stats to feed, 14 to 16 each at the start. These classes start between levels 11 and 15 with a staff or seal and a weapon: magma, storm, night, spirits, black flame, frenzy.

priest.name: Priest
priest.text: Faith from 16 to 18, an incantation seal and a melee weapon. Fundamentalist has the highest Faith (18), Flame Prophet starts at level 7 with 17.

status.name: Status and corruption
status.text: Faith and Arcane together, 14 to 16. Rot and poison for Servant of Rot, sleep for Mystic, bloodflame for Blood Initiate. Perfumer crafts their own consumables.

odd.name: Unusual starts
odd.text: Prisoner: level 1, 10 in everything, a club. Perfumer: level 5, perfumes, pots and a crossbow, no starting spells.

home.martialNote: Martial classes (melee and ranged) have armor abilities that only work while no weapon or catalyst with Intelligence or Faith scaling is equipped. Marksman is the exception for its bows, crossbows and ballistae. The Prisoner only gets the full benefit of its notable armor at Rune Level 1.
home.tableNote: Each column is shaded from the lowest to the highest value in the list. Click a name to add it to the comparison.
home.footer1: Data: class pages from the official site <site>convergencemod.com</site>, checked on October 19, 2026. Starting levels and stats are copied from the class pages. The playstyle groupings are my interpretation, not an official ranking. The mod evolves: check in game if a number looks off.
home.footer2: Detail pages: armor, weapons, catalysts and spell runes taken from the class pages and rune pages of the same site. Acquisition conditions were summarized; item and place names are kept as in the game. The weapons listed are the ones on the class page, not a build guide. The site's pages sometimes disagree on a location (Blood Initiate's rune, Mystic's start): when in doubt, trust what you see in game. Zones (Limgrave, Liurnia…) are sorted from my knowledge of the game and cross-checked on the wiki when possible; "zone to confirm" flags a doubt. The ↗ links go to the Fextralife wiki and Map Genie; I couldn't test the interactive maps from here.

Checked talismans are saved with your progress. Names link to the site's item database, or to the Fextralife wiki when it doesn't know them.

These sources sometimes disagree: such cases are flagged with ⚠. None gives the nearest site of grace. Item names link to their page in the site's item database, which lists the links to the wikis; names it doesn't know link to the Fextralife wiki (base game). items.intro: Weapons, shields, catalysts, armor, talismans and jewels of The Convergence, with their effects, taken from the mod wiki, with their spells and ashes. Search a name or a word from the effect ("bleed", "charge", "faith").

tip.weight: Adds to your equip load: the heavier it is, the slower your roll.
tip.upgrade: Material used to reinforce the item. Smithing: regular weapon, its Ash of War can be changed. Somber: unique weapon, fixed skill. Glovewort: spirit ashes.
tip.skill: The weapon's skill, used with the skill button. Its FP cost is in brackets.
tip.crit: Multiplier for critical hits: ripostes after a parry, backstabs and hits on a downed enemy. 100% = normal; 130% = 30% more critical damage.
tip.range: Maximum shooting distance of the bow or crossbow.
tip.dmg: Base damage by type: Phy (physical), Mag (magic), Fire, Ltn (lightning), Hol (holy). Scaling adds to it based on your stats.
tip.guard: Share of damage blocked when guarding, by type (100 = fully blocked). Guard boost reduces the stamina lost on each blocked hit.
tip.mul: Power of spells cast with this catalyst, by damage type. 100% = full power.
tip.req: Minimum stats to wield the item properly: STR Strength, DEX Dexterity, INT Intelligence, FTH Faith, ARC Arcane. Below them, the item is heavily weakened.
tip.scale: Damage gained from each stat, from E (little) to S (a lot). Reinforcing the weapon raises this bonus.
tip.status: Buildup on each hit: when the enemy's gauge fills, the effect triggers. The higher the number, the sooner it triggers.
tip.fp: Focus points (FP) spent on each cast.
tip.slots: Memory slots the spell takes up once equipped.
tip.debuff: Reduces your HP, FP and stamina while the spirit is summoned.

items.footer: Source: the <wiki>mod wiki</wiki>, accessed October 20, 2026. Descriptions, effects and locations are copied as written on the wiki, in English. Some wiki pages are still incomplete (⚠), most ashes of war only list where to get them, and the mod keeps evolving: when in doubt, trust what you see in game.
